top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs the most mature, best-validated method on the shortlist (Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling, cleanly attributed to Buchwald and Hartwig, mechanism stated in physical-organic terms) with base editing credited to Liu alone, a defined chemical transformation on DNA that has been independently reproduced and is already in patients. Three laureates fits the limit. If Liu alone is contested, B008 should give way, so P002 is my second choice, then P004.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, but no candidate in the slate is connected to Stockholm University
